what: wave-76 76-c H1 rescue via rarity-biased cap + D* dial calibration - stamped pre-expectations
entropy_protocol: w74_stream UNCHANGED: blake2b('w74-chaotic-fallback:'+arm+':'+rep) -> PCG64, fast-forward 4g; arm encodes config ('base600' registered cap, 'rarity600' rescue, 'p{p*:.6f}_t1.0' verification)

R_registered_cap.note: instrumented registered cap-4-oldest-drops; draw-identical to 75-d base600 -> must reproduce 75-d receipt (integrity check, blocking)

X_rarity_cap.rule: overflow drops most-common-held type's newest copy; ties by (-hc, -birth, type, iid); no RNG consumed

V_verification.P_SPLIT: p* = exp((ln 30 - a)/b) from T4 fit on 75-d T=1.0 cells

definitions.rarity: hc(t) = number of distinct cells holding >=1 copy of type t over the whole live pool at drop time (pre-removal, overflow included)
definitions.per_tick_drop_rate: class drops / 599 instrumented gens (gens 2..600); pooled = sum over 3 seeds / 1797

verdict_rules.T1: pooled drops_rare/drops_common >= 1.5 (PASS); drops_common==0 & rare>0 -> inf PASS; total drops==0 -> INCONCLUSIVE; per-seed ratios reported
verdict_rules.T2: H_pool(300-600) rarity > registered on >= 2 of 3 seeds (paired per rep)
verdict_rules.T3: per-seed [H_pool(300-600) - H_pool(20-70)] >= 0.05 nats on >= 2 of 3 seeds (rarity arm)
verdict_rules.T4: ln D* ~ a + b.ln P_SPLIT on the four T=1.0 cells of the 75-d receipt: R^2 >= 0.9 AND measured D* at p* (mean D_star_stat, 2 seeds, 240 gens) within [20, 45] (factor 1.5 of target 30)

integrity_check: instrumented base600 runs must reproduce 75-d per-gen H_pool (abs<=1e-12) and D_star_raw (exact); mismatch -> ABORT before arms X/V, fix, re-run, document

T1.grounding: cap drops oldest-by-birth; gA homogenization concentrates birth refresh on common types; rare lineages age out

T2.counter_risk: (a) channel keeps minting homogenized common types; rarity drop only lowers holder count when it takes a cell's last copy

runtime_guard: expected < 10 min wall; if > 30 min BOOK overage and continue (no grid reduction permitted; seeds fixed by mission)
